Strong strategic thinking, stakeholder management, communication and influencing capabilities. Ability to translate broad strategic objectives into practical initiatives and deliver outcomes through collaboration. Experience managing a small, agile team and working across multiple organisations without relying on large institutional resources. Strong written and verbal communication skills. The Executive Director will help establish MBN as an effective industry execution and connectivity platform; one that converts industry priorities into action, strengthens international relationships and facilitates greater cross-border Islamic finance activity originated, managed and supported from Malaysia.

IOM aims at promoting the integration of beneficiaries of international protection and temporary protection into the Greek society through activities for employability support, the provision of Greek language courses and vocational training, the support for independent living, including rental subsidies, activities promoting social cohesion and inclusion. Responsibilities Under the overall supervision of the Project Team Lead (Employability and Education) and the direct supervision of the Project Assistant (Employability), the successful candidate will have the following duties and responsibilities: Support labour market integration through individual and group career counselling sessions.
